dns_manager.title: DNS Manager Configuration
dns_manager.description:
This dictionary provides the DNS Manager configuration for synchronizing DNS records across multiple providers (Active Directory, Infoblox, BlueCat, etc.).

Optional fields are:
  * `vault`
  * `providers`
  * `inventory`

providers.title: DNS Providers
providers.description: Dictionary of DNS provider configurations keyed by provider name.

inventory.title: Inventory Sources
inventory.description: Dictionary of inventory source configurations keyed by inventory name.

records.title: DNS Records
records.description: List of DNS A records to be created. This section is auto-generated by the DNS Manager when parsing inventory files.

vault_config.title: HashiCorp Vault Configuration
vault_config.description: HashiCorp Vault configuration for secure credential storage.

enabled.title: Enable Vault
enabled.description: Enable Vault integration for credential storage.

path_prefix.title: Vault Path Prefix
path_prefix.description: Base path for secrets in Vault (e.g., secret/data/cisco-ai-pods).

auth_method.title: Authentication Method
auth_method.description: Vault authentication method (token, ldap, or approle).

auth_token_env.title: Vault Token Environment Variable
auth_token_env.description: Environment variable containing Vault authentication token.

active_directory_provider.title: Active Directory DNS Provider
active_directory_provider.description: Configuration for Active Directory DNS provider.

use_shared_ldap.title: Use Shared LDAP Configuration
use_shared_ldap.description: The default value is `false`. When set to `true`, inherits LDAP bind_dn, server, and domain from shared_services.ldap configuration in the Initial Inventory. This avoids duplicating LDAP configuration. If true, explicit server, domain, and bind_dn values are ignored.

server.title: Active Directory Server
server.description: Active Directory server FQDN or IP address.

domain.title: DNS Domain
domain.description: DNS domain name managed by this Active Directory.

ldap_port.title: LDAP Port
ldap_port.description: The default value is `389`. LDAP port for connection.

secure_ldap_port.title: Secure LDAP Port
secure_ldap_port.description: The default value is `636`. Secure LDAP (LDAPS) port.

use_ssl.title: Use SSL/TLS
use_ssl.description: The default value is `false`. Use SSL/TLS for LDAP connection.

password.title: Bind Password
password.description: Password for LDAP bind. Use Vault path in production (vault_path takes precedence).

vault_path.title: Vault Credentials Path
vault_path.description: Path to credentials in Vault (overrides password field). Format: path/to/credentials.

timeout.title: Connection Timeout
timeout.description: The default value is `10`. Connection timeout in seconds.

server.title: Infoblox Grid Master
server.description: Infoblox Grid Master FQDN or IP address.

password.title: API Password
password.description: Password for Infoblox API. Use Vault path in production (vault_path takes precedence).

vault_path.title: Vault Credentials Path
vault_path.description: Path to credentials in Vault (overrides password field).

use_ssl.title: Use HTTPS
use_ssl.description: The default value is `true`. Use HTTPS for API communication.

verify_ssl.title: Verify SSL Certificates
verify_ssl.description: The default value is `true`. Verify SSL certificate validity.

wapi_port.title: WAPI Port
wapi_port.description: The default value is `443`. Infoblox WAPI port.

timeout.title: API Request Timeout
timeout.description: The default value is `30`. API request timeout in seconds.

bind_provider.title: BIND DNS Provider
bind_provider.description: Configuration for BIND DNS provider using nsupdate or zone file management.

server.title: BIND Server
server.description: BIND DNS server FQDN or IP address.

zone_file_path.title: Zone File Path
zone_file_path.description: Path to zone files on the BIND server (e.g., /var/lib/named/zones).

nsupdate.title: Use nsupdate
nsupdate.description: The default value is `true`. Use nsupdate for dynamic updates instead of direct file management.

tsig_key.title: TSIG Key
tsig_key.description: TSIG key name for authenticated nsupdate requests.

tsig_keyfile.title: TSIG Key File
tsig_keyfile.description: Path to TSIG keyfile for authentication (e.g., /etc/named.keys/update.key).

timeout.title: Operation Timeout
timeout.description: The default value is `10`. Operation timeout in seconds.

server.title: BlueCat Server
server.description: BlueCat Proteus server FQDN or IP address.

password.title: API Password
password.description: Password for BlueCat API. Use Vault path in production.

timeout.title: API Request Timeout
timeout.description: The default value is `30`. API request timeout in seconds.

efficientip_provider.title: EfficientIP DNS Provider
efficientip_provider.description: Configuration for EfficientIP (Efficient IP) DNS provider.

server.title: EfficientIP Server
server.description: EfficientIP DNS server FQDN or IP address.

password.title: API Password
password.description: Password for EfficientIP API. Use Vault path in production.

timeout.title: API Request Timeout
timeout.description: The default value is `30`. API request timeout in seconds.

inventory_source.title: Inventory Source
inventory_source.description: Configuration for an inventory data source (OpenShift, Intersight, EveryPure, etc.).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The default value is `true`. Enable this inventory source.

format.title: File Format
format.description: The default value is `yaml`. Format of the inventory file.

dns_record.title: DNS A Record
dns_record.description: A DNS A record with hostname and IPv4 address.
